n: Hiwonder ArmPi FPV and ArmPi mini
t: A Raspberry Pi robotic arm with a camera and Python AI vision tutorials.
steps: Choose a kit tier and buy it from Hiwonder or a reseller.
Gather a Raspberry Pi 4B or 5 and a 7.5V 6A power supply.
Flash or boot the Raspberry Pi image.
Connect the camera and check the cable.
Move on to the Python tutorials.
